requirements.source_title: Periodic Review of Data Cybersecurity Controls
requirements.source_text: With reference to ECC control 1-8-1, the cybersecurity function in the organization must review the implementation of the Data Cybersecurity Controls periodically as specified for each data classification level.At least annually
requirements.source_summary: The cybersecurity function must periodically review implementation of the Data Cybersecurity Controls according to the applicable data classification level; the supplied text specifies at least annually.

todo.name: Establish and execute the required periodic control review
todo.description: Assign the cybersecurity function responsibility for reviewing implementation of the Data Cybersecurity Controls at least annually, while documenting the applicable data classification frequency without inferring any omitted frequency requirements.

policies.name: Data Cybersecurity Controls Review Policy
policies.description: Define the cybersecurity function’s responsibility, review scope, classification-based frequency, approval, and follow-up requirements for reviewing implementation of the Data Cybersecurity Controls.

documents.name: Data Cybersecurity Controls Review Procedure
documents.description: Document the review method, control-owner confirmations, classification-based schedule, findings handling, and corrective-action tracking.

documents.name: Annual Control Review Plan
documents.description: Record the controls in scope, responsible reviewers, planned dates, applicable data classifications, and review status.

evidence.name: Completed Control Review Reports
evidence.description: Retain dated review reports showing the controls reviewed, implementation status, identified gaps, and assigned remediation actions.

evidence.name: Review Schedule and Remediation Tracker
evidence.description: Provide evidence of the annual review schedule, completion, approvals, and closure or tracking of resulting actions.

requirements.source_text: With reference to ECC control 1-8-2, cybersecurity review and audit must be conducted periodically by independent parties outside the organization’s cybersecurity function as specified for each data classification level.At least every 2yearsAt least annually
requirements.source_summary: Cybersecurity reviews and audits must be conducted periodically by independent parties outside the organization’s cybersecurity function according to the applicable data classification level; the supplied text includes frequencies of at least every two years and at least annually.

todo.name: Schedule independent cybersecurity reviews and audits
todo.description: Appoint qualified parties outside the cybersecurity function to perform the required reviews or audits according to each applicable data classification frequency, recording the selected frequency without assuming which frequency applies to which classification.

policies.name: Independent Cybersecurity Audit Policy
policies.description: Define independence requirements, auditor appointment and competence, classification-based audit frequency, scope, reporting, and remediation follow-up.

documents.name: Independent Audit Plan
documents.description: Record the audit scope, applicable data classifications, required frequency, independent auditor, dates, deliverables, and responsible management owners.

documents.name: Audit Findings and Remediation Register
documents.description: Track findings, risk treatment, accountable owners, target dates, status, and closure approval.

evidence.name: Independent Audit Reports
evidence.description: Retain reports issued by parties outside the cybersecurity function, including scope, date, conclusions, findings, and recommendations.

evidence.name: Auditor Independence and Engagement Records
evidence.description: Provide engagement documents demonstrating the auditor’s independence from the cybersecurity function and evidence of management review.

evidence.name: Remediation Closure Evidence
evidence.description: Show corrective-action records and supporting evidence for addressing audit findings.

requirements.source_title: Human Resources Cybersecurity Requirements for Data Handling
requirements.source_text:
In addition to the subcontrols in the ECC control 1-9-3, cybersecurity requirements in human resources prior to employment, during employment and after termination/separation must include at least the following:
1-2-1-1 Screening andvetting candidates injobsrelated to data handling.
1-2-1-2 A signed agreement by personnel pledging to not use social media,communication applicationsor personal cloud storageto create, store or share the Cybersecurity Defense
requirements.source_summary: The supplied text requires cybersecurity requirements for personnel before employment, during employment, and after termination or separation, and expressly includes screening and vetting candidates for data-handling jobs and a signed personnel agreement restricting specified uses of social media, communication applications, and personal cloud storage for Cybersecurity Defense.

todo.name: Implement personnel screening and signed data-handling commitments
todo.description: For roles related to data handling, perform and document candidate screening and vetting, and obtain a signed personnel agreement covering the restrictions stated in the supplied text; do not infer or add requirements beyond the truncated source content.

policies.name: Personnel Data-Handling Security Policy
policies.description: Define screening and vetting requirements for data-handling roles, required personnel commitments, approval responsibilities, and controls applicable before employment, during employment, and after termination or separation.

policies.name: Acceptable Technology and Data Use Policy
policies.description: State the personnel restrictions on using social media, communication applications, and personal cloud storage to create, store, or share the Cybersecurity Defense content identified in the supplied requirement.

documents.name: Candidate Screening and Vetting Procedure
documents.description: Document the screening workflow, role applicability, approvals, completion status, and handling of screening records for data-handling positions.

documents.name: Personnel Cybersecurity Agreement Template
documents.description: Create the signed agreement containing the source-specified commitment and restrictions, without adding obligations based on omitted text.

documents.name: Termination and Separation Checklist
documents.description: Record completion of applicable cybersecurity actions at separation, while acknowledging that the supplied text does not provide the full list of post-termination actions.

evidence.name: Completed Screening Records
evidence.description: Retain authorized evidence that candidates for data-handling jobs were screened and vetted.

evidence.name: Signed Personnel Agreements
evidence.description: Provide signed agreements from applicable personnel containing the stated cybersecurity commitment and restrictions.

evidence.name: Employment Lifecycle Compliance Records
evidence.description: Provide records showing application of the documented requirements before employment, during employment, and at separation, with any unprovided source details clearly identified as pending clarification.

requirements.source_title: Restricted and Approved Data Access Privileges
requirements.source_text:
In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-2-3, cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management must cover at least the following:
2-1-1-1 Strict restriction toallow only the minimum number of personnel accessing, viewingand sharingdata based on lists of privileges limited to Saudi-national employees unless exempted bythe Authorizing Official(the head of the organization or his/her delegate) and those lists are approved by the Authorizing Official.
2-1-1-2 Prohibiting the sharing of approved lists of privileges with unauthorized persons.
requirements.source_summary: Access, viewing, and sharing of data must be strictly limited to the minimum number of personnel through approved privilege lists, subject to the stated Saudi-national employee condition or an Authorizing Official exemption. Approved privilege lists must not be shared with unauthorized persons.

todo.name: Create and enforce approved minimum-access privilege lists
todo.description: Identify personnel requiring data access, restrict access, viewing, and sharing to the minimum necessary number, apply the stated Saudi-national employee condition or obtain an Authorizing Official exemption, secure approval of the privilege lists, and prevent disclosure to unauthorized persons.

policies.name: Data Identity and Access Management Policy
policies.description: Define least-privilege access, the Saudi-national employee restriction, Authorizing Official exemptions and approvals, access to viewing and sharing functions, and protection of approved privilege lists.

policies.name: Privilege List Confidentiality Policy
policies.description: Specify authorized recipients, handling, storage, transmission, and disclosure restrictions for approved privilege lists.

documents.name: Approved Data Privilege Register
documents.description: Maintain the approved list of personnel authorized to access, view, or share each relevant data set, including approval, justification, classification, and any Authorizing Official exemption.

documents.name: Access Request and Approval Procedure
documents.description: Document requests, minimum-access assessment, eligibility or exemption review, Authorizing Official approval, provisioning, and removal.

documents.name: Privilege List Distribution Register
documents.description: Record who may receive or access approved privilege lists and the approved method of distribution.

evidence.name: Authorizing Official Approvals
evidence.description: Provide signed or system-recorded approvals for privilege lists and documented exemptions.

evidence.name: Access Control System Records
evidence.description: Show that only approved personnel received the permitted access, viewing, and sharing privileges.

evidence.name: Privilege List Access Logs
evidence.description: Retain logs or equivalent records demonstrating that approved privilege lists were not shared with unauthorized persons.

requirements.source_text: In addition to ECC subcontrol 2-2-3-5,the approved lists of privilegesand privileges used to handle data must be reviewedas specified for each data classification level.At least annuallyAt least every 3 months
requirements.source_summary: Approved privilege lists and privileges used to handle data must be reviewed according to the applicable data classification level; the supplied text includes frequencies of at least annually and at least every three months.

todo.name: Perform classification-based privilege reviews
todo.description: Review approved privilege lists and data-handling privileges at the applicable classification-based frequency, including the supplied annual and three-month intervals as applicable, and record approval or remediation decisions.

policies.name: Data Privilege Review Policy
policies.description: Define review ownership, classification-based review frequency, review criteria, Authorizing Official approval, exception handling, and removal or adjustment of inappropriate privileges.

documents.name: Privilege Review Procedure
documents.description: Document how reviewers validate personnel eligibility, business need, access, viewing, and sharing privileges and record required changes.

documents.name: Privilege Review Schedule and Register
documents.description: Track each approved privilege list, data classification, applicable review frequency, review date, reviewer, outcome, and next due date.

evidence.name: Completed Privilege Review Records
evidence.description: Provide dated reviews showing the approved lists and data-handling privileges examined, decisions made, and approvals obtained.

evidence.name: Access Change and Revocation Tickets
evidence.description: Show timely removal or modification of privileges identified as unnecessary or noncompliant.

evidence.name: Review Exception Records
evidence.description: Retain documented justification and approval for any unresolved review findings or exceptions.

requirements.source_title: Security Patching for Systems Handling Data
requirements.source_text:
In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-3-3, cybersecurity requirements for Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection must include at least the following:
2-2-1-1 Applying security patches and updates from the time of announcement onsystems used to handle data as specified for each data classification level.At least everymonthImmediately
requirements.source_summary: Systems used to handle data must receive security patches and updates from the time of announcement according to the applicable data classification level; the supplied text includes at least monthly and immediately.

todo.name: Apply announced security patches and updates to data-handling systems
todo.description: Maintain an inventory of systems used to handle data, map each system to the applicable data classification frequency, and deploy announced security patches and updates immediately or at least monthly as applicable, recording exceptions without inferring omitted classification mappings.

policies.name: Data-Handling System Patching Policy
policies.description: Define patch sources, classification-based deployment timelines, ownership, testing, emergency handling, exception approval, and reporting for systems used to handle data.

documents.name: Security Patch Management Procedure
documents.description: Document announcement intake, asset applicability assessment, testing, deployment, rollback, exception handling, and verification.

documents.name: Data-Handling System and Patch Register
documents.description: Track systems, data classification, announced patches, required deployment interval, deployment status, and approved exceptions.

evidence.name: Patch Deployment Reports
evidence.description: Provide system records showing announcement dates, patch installation dates, affected data-handling systems, and deployment outcomes.

evidence.name: Patch Compliance Dashboard or Register
evidence.description: Show compliance with the applicable immediate or monthly timelines and identify overdue systems.

evidence.name: Approved Patch Exceptions
evidence.description: Retain documented risk acceptance, compensating measures, approval, and expiry for systems not patched within the applicable period.

requirements.source_title: Third-Party Cybersecurity Requirements for Data Sharing and Handling
requirements.source_text:
In addition to the controls in ECC subdomain 4-1, cybersecurity requirements for third-parties cybersecurity must include at least the following:
3-1-1-1 Screening orvetting third-party employees who have access to the data.
3-1-1-2 Requiring contractual commitment by third-partiesto securely dispose the organization’s data at the end of the contract or in case of contract termination, including providing evidences of such disposal to the organization.
3-1-1-3 Documentingall data sharing operations within third-parties, including data sharing justification.
3-1-1-4 When transferring data outside the kingdom, the capability of the hosting organization abroad to safeguard data must be verified, approval ofthe Authorizing Officialmust be obtained and complyingwith related laws and regulations.
3-1-1-5 Requiring third-parties to notify the organization immediately in case of cybersecurity incident that may affect data that has been shared or created.
3-1-1-6 Reclassifying data to the least level to achieve the objective before sharing it with third-parties using data masking or data scrambling techniques.
requirements.source_summary: Third parties with data access must be screened or vetted, contractually commit to secure disposal and provide disposal evidence, document data sharing and its justification, meet specified safeguards and approvals for transfers outside the Kingdom, promptly report relevant incidents, and apply least-level reclassification using masking or scrambling before sharing where required.

todo.name: Implement third-party data-sharing and disposal controls
todo.description: For each third party handling or receiving data, complete employee screening or vetting, include secure-disposal and incident-notification commitments in the contract, document sharing justifications, verify safeguards and obtain Authorizing Official approval before transfers outside the Kingdom, and apply the stated reclassification, masking, or scrambling requirement before sharing.

policies.name: Third-Party Data Security Policy
policies.description: Define third-party screening, data-sharing approval and justification, overseas-transfer verification, incident notification, data reclassification, masking or scrambling, and secure-disposal requirements.

policies.name: Third-Party Contract Security Policy
policies.description: Mandate contractual clauses for secure disposal, provision of disposal evidence, immediate notification of relevant cybersecurity incidents, and other source-specified obligations.

documents.name: Third-Party Due Diligence Procedure
documents.description: Document screening or vetting of third-party employees with data access and verification of an overseas hosting organization’s capability to safeguard data.

documents.name: Data Sharing Register
documents.description: Record each third-party sharing operation, data involved, justification, classification before and after any reclassification, transfer location, approvals, and safeguards.

documents.name: Third-Party Security Addendum
documents.description: Provide contract language requiring secure disposal, disposal evidence, immediate incident notification, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

documents.name: Third-Party Offboarding and Data Disposal Procedure
documents.description: Document end-of-contract or termination disposal steps, evidence collection, and validation of disposal completion.

evidence.name: Third-Party Screening and Vetting Records
evidence.description: Provide records showing screening or vetting of third-party employees who have access to data.

evidence.name: Executed Contracts and Security Addenda
evidence.description: Show signed contractual commitments for secure disposal, disposal evidence, incident notification, and applicable transfer obligations.

evidence.name: Data Sharing and Transfer Approvals
evidence.description: Provide documented sharing justifications, Authorizing Official approvals for transfers outside the Kingdom, safeguard verification, and applicable legal or regulatory compliance checks.

evidence.name: Disposal Certificates or Other Disposal Evidence
evidence.description: Retain evidence supplied by third parties demonstrating secure disposal at contract completion or termination.

evidence.name: Incident Notification Records
evidence.description: Provide third-party notifications and internal handling records for cybersecurity incidents that may affect shared or created data.

evidence.name: Data Masking or Scrambling Records
evidence.description: Show reclassification decisions and technical evidence that masking or scrambling was applied before the relevant third-party sharing.
